svg.title: Seven caps above the cut
svg.desc: Fixed ambient geometry · cap identities A–G retained Intersecting the seven nontrivial upper parts with z ≥ 1/7 yields these caps. The B-ray optimum argument uses this reduction only after a witness establishes that its optimum lies above 1/7. The picture omits the rest of the complete 1/8-safe atlas. Each panel is independently fitted: their positions and screen sizes are not a common coordinate plot.
